column3: DE/rand/1/bin; the trial replaces its target only if it dominates it; external archive stores non-dominated trials.
column4: • Excellent on P5 (HV 0.836, IGD 0.006) †.; • Fast (0.7s) †.; • Only F and CR.; • Self-adapting step sizes.; • Archive keeps best solutions seen.
column5: • Collapsed to 1 point on P3 (HV 0.110, IGD 0.610) †.; • 'Only if dominates' keeps the target in every incomparable case, so diversity is not rewarded and the population drifts to one end of the front.; • Real variables only.; • Archive after 10,000 evaluations: 1 point on P3 vs 98 for MO-TLBO †.; • Sensitive to F, CR.
